verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe two vendor-cloud-free paths. Local-only mode disables Anytype's backup node entirely and syncs only over the local network, and a self-hosted network setup uses a team-maintained Docker image. Data is stored locally and the app is offline-first, and the team describes p2p LAN sync working without a central server. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of running the self-hosted backend, and a smoother switch to it (it currently requires exporting channels and re-importing them into a new identity).
